questions.question: The UK tax year runs from…
questions.explanation: The tax year runs from 6 April to 5 April.

questions.question: The standard Personal Allowance (income you can earn tax-free) is…
questions.explanation: The standard Personal Allowance is £12,570. It's reduced for very high earners.

questions.question: How much savings interest can a basic-rate taxpayer earn tax-free (Personal Savings Allowance)?
questions.explanation: Basic-rate taxpayers get £1,000. Higher-rate taxpayers get £500.

questions.question: The Personal Savings Allowance for a higher-rate taxpayer is…
questions.explanation: Higher-rate taxpayers get £500. Additional-rate taxpayers get nothing.

questions.question: HMRC's trading allowance lets you earn how much a year in side income before you need to tell them?
questions.explanation: The trading allowance covers up to £1,000 of gross trading income.

questions.question: Selling your own old clothes online for less than you paid is usually…
options: Not trading, so normally no tax
questions.explanation: Selling personal belongings isn't trading. Buying items to resell for profit is.

questions.question: Online marketplaces now share seller details with HMRC once you sell around…
options: 30 items, or about £1,700, in a year
questions.explanation: Platforms report sellers who hit 30 sales or about £1,700 a year. Reporting isn't the same as owing tax.
questions.verify: Digital platform reporting thresholds on gov.uk

questions.question: The deadline for filing an online Self Assessment tax return is…
options: 31 January after the tax year ends
questions.explanation: Online returns are due by 31 January after the end of the tax year.

questions.question: The dividend allowance (2026/27) is…
questions.explanation: You can earn £500 of dividends tax-free outside an ISA.

questions.question: The Capital Gains Tax annual exempt amount is…
questions.explanation: You can make £3,000 of gains a year tax-free outside an ISA.
questions.verify: CGT annual exempt amount on gov.uk

questions.question: Marriage Allowance lets a lower earner transfer…
options: £1,260 of their Personal Allowance to a basic-rate partner
questions.explanation: Eligible couples can transfer £1,260, which saves up to £252 a year.

questions.question: Does Cash ISA interest use up your Personal Savings Allowance?
options: No: ISA interest is tax-free and separate
questions.explanation: ISA interest doesn't count towards your Personal Savings Allowance.

questions.question: Your tax code tells your employer…
options: How much tax-free pay you get
questions.explanation: The tax code reflects your allowances so the right tax is taken.

questions.question: National Insurance contributions build up your entitlement to…
questions.explanation: Your NI record decides your State Pension.

questions.question: You earn £800 from a small side hustle and have no other self-employed income. Under the trading allowance…
options: You normally don't need to tell HMRC
questions.explanation: Under £1,000 of gross trading income is usually covered by the trading allowance.

questions.question: Miss the 31 January Self Assessment deadline and you usually…
options: Get an automatic £100 penalty, even if you owe no tax
questions.explanation: Penalties grow the longer the return is late.

questions.question: A P60 is…
options: A yearly summary of your pay and tax from your employer
questions.explanation: Keep it, because you'll need it for mortgages, tax refunds and claims.

questions.question: An emergency tax code on a new job means…
options: You may pay too much tax until HMRC updates your code
questions.explanation: Overpaid tax is usually refunded once your code is corrected.

questions.question: Your tax code looks wrong. Who do you check with?
options: HMRC, through your personal tax account
questions.explanation: You can view and update your details online.

questions.question: Marriage Allowance lets you transfer how much of your Personal Allowance?
questions.explanation: You can transfer £1,260, saving up to £252 a year, and it can be backdated up to 4 years.

questions.question: What is the best way to claim Marriage Allowance?
questions.explanation: Apply for free on gov.uk. Some firms charge a cut of your refund for something you can do in minutes.
